Example

From a description to steps.

A made-up example, showing the first steps.

What you enter

Process: Closing the cafe
“count the register, clean the espresso machine, put milk away, take out trash, lock up and set the alarm”

What you get
Steps
  • Count the register and record the total on the closing sheet
  • Clean the espresso machine — warning: let the steam wand cool before wiping it
  • Return all milk and dairy to the walk-in cooler

How it works

FAQ

Common questions.

What's an SOP?
A standard operating procedure is a written, step-by-step guide for a task, so it's done the same way every time — whoever does it.
Can I write company policies too?
Yes — that's the Policy Generator.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
SOP Generator is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
